procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (54 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side: labels 21 and 33 absent (count_gate.gaps), label 26 printed twice (T/F q026, match q026b); 56 questions. Answer side: 1-26 continuous (T/F keys 16-26 incl. an orphan key 21 with no question), [match block], 27-32, 34-56 (33 absent like its question). All keys pair by printed number; q057 (draw) no key. Difficulty per question: easy 39, average 1, difficult 15, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 42 (heading, LO) 43-46; A pdf 145 (heading, keys 1-3) 146-147.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-26 (no 21; q26 'The woodpeckars create their nest…' prints no answer space); s4 '26. Match the following with appropriate answers. (easy)' q026b (8 rows, Q-side labels garbled e)/(r)/(h)); s5 one mark q27-37 (no 33) vsa; s6 two marks q38-47 sa; s7 three marks q48-52 sa; s8 four marks q53-57 la.

NUMBERING: label 26 printed twice (pdf 44: T/F '26. The woodpeckars…' and '26. Match the following…') -> q026, q026b. Labels 21, 33 absent -> gaps. Answer side: '21. True' is an ORPHAN key (extraction.orphan_keys) — numbered, but every key after it still fits its question by printed number, so it displaces nothing (v2 §4.5); not paired with anything.

Text-layer joins on the key side split by hand: 'State whether … (Easy): 16. False' (heading + key 16 on one line), '29. Tall buildings with many floors 30. Cement sheets', '45. Bricks, cement, metal sheets 46. Bamboo is light…'.
Tags printed without '(' read as tags: q49 'compared?Average)', q53 'society?Difficult)'. q52 prints no tag -> 'no difficulty tag'. q57 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_10.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.

orphan_keys.note: T/F key with no printed question 21 (question side jumps 20 -> 22); keys 22-26 still fit their questions by printed number, so it shifts nothing (v2 §4.5 sequence test)
